verdict.rationale: Rev AI's feature docs state that the JSON transcription output includes timestamps for every transcribed word, and the product site markets precise word-level timestamps, so each word maps to its position in the recording. The evidence is first-party only and thin on detail. Missing for 10: documentation of the timestamp field structure and precision (e.g., start/end values per word), confirmation that streaming results also carry word timestamps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get word-level timestamps so every word maps to its position in the recording

citations.quote: The JSON transcription output includes timestamps for every transcribed word.
